Emily — attaching a first-pass MAP for Cardinal (cardinal_mpa_v2.docx). High-level sequencing we propose: 

- Week 0 (MSA draft): Redwood sends MSA + order form (limited scope) for Cardinal legal review.
- Week 1 (Security evidence): Redwood shares SOC2 report and runbook snippets; security questionnaire answers due in parallel.
- Week 2 (Procurement): Procurement finalizes PO terms; order form pricing locked; procurement issues PO conditional on signed MSA.
- Week 3 (Signature): Sign MSA (DocuSign). Order form effective upon signature.
- Week 4–6 (DPA): DPA executed in parallel but can be queued to complete within two weeks post-MSA if Cardinal prefers staggered approach.

Key gating artifacts: SOC2-report (we provided link), security questionnaire, redline of MSA. Owners: Redwood legal (Kimberly) will own MSA redline consolidation; Cardinal legal (Susan?) to own their redline loop. Marcus will own procurement handoff and pricing confirmation.

Questions for you: 1) Do you want the DPA signed simultaneously with the MSA or shortly after? 2) Who is your legal lead (email) so we can add them to the MAP doc?

Attachment: cardinal_mpa_v2.docx (MAP draft)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m sync if helpful.

— Avery Johnson
Director, Solutions Sales

2) Produce DPA redline target: we will aim to finalize DPA by 2026-09-22. If Cardinal prefers, we can sign the DPA concurrently; otherwise DPA signature can be conditional with a POA (proof of availability) and SOC2 evidence in the interim.
3) Security gate: Redwood will provide SOC2-report-cardinal-2025.pdf and a completed security questionnaire by 2026-09-06. Cardinal security team may request a short follow-up 30-minute call.

Who owns each item (proposal):
- MSA consolidation & DocuSign link: Kimberly Park (Redwood Legal)
- DPA negotiation: Kimberly + Susan (Cardinal counsel)
- Procurement / PO issuance: Marcus Lin (Redwood) + Cardinal Procurement Team
- Security evidence: Redwood Security Ops (report attached)

Next steps: Kimberly will upload a consolidated MSA redline and a DocuSign ready package by EOD 2026-09-06. Marcus — can you confirm the billing contact and PO cadence so we can reflect that in the MAP?
